name: Income Certificate (Maharashtra)
description: Certificate stating the annual income of a family, issued through Aaple Sarkar / MahaOnline for various welfare and scholarship purposes.
eligibility: Residents of Maharashtra requiring proof of family income.
benefits: Required for scholarships, fee concessions, reservations and welfare schemes.
application_steps: Fill applicant details and upload documents.
Track application; download the digitally signed certificate.
processing_time: 15 working days (as per RTS Act service standard).
ai_summary: Income Certificate (Maharashtra) is a state government service under Revenue Department in the Certificates category, available online.
ai_explanation: Income Certificate (Maharashtra) is Certificate stating the annual income of a family, issued through Aaple Sarkar / MahaOnline for various welfare and scholarship purposes. Eligibility: Residents of Maharashtra requiring proof of family income.. Benefits: Required for scholarships, fee concessions, reservations and welfare schemes.. You can apply online via https://aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in. Processing time is typically 15 working days (as per RTS Act service standard). and fees are Nominal (approx Rs.33-40 via Aaple Sarkar)..
